title: Bnon
summary: King listed in CFAH-8 Table 6 (Egypt Dynasty 15 (Hyksos)).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 15 (Hyksos). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-8 (Table 6, "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 15").

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (CFAH non-anchor dates). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: Start Sole-rex: 1472; Death or Deposition: 1428. Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-11-13): was none.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-8: Placing Dynasties 15-18," OSF preprint v1.2 (29 Apr 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/Z5RTD, file CFAH-8_v1.2.pdf, Table 6 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 15", p. 87
BLK SHP Scott, Dynasty of Slaves, Chapter 2, What Happened After Joseph?
reign.note: How long he says the rulers he identifies with Jacob’s family held Avaris under Bnon. A duration, not a BC year.

reign.citation: BLK SHP Scott, Dynasty of Slaves, Introduction, Discovering the Cast of Characters
reign.note: He identifies Bnon, sometimes written Beon, with Benjamin through Ben-Oni. His view. bnon and beon stay separate.
